scenario: Brace escapes `{{` and `}}` per LGRA.2.9.6.7: a `log` message `"a {{literal}} brace pair"` compiles. Read as an interpolation site, `literal` would be an unresolved name. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: no message is rendered, so the literal braces are not observed.

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:

->
